original_test_intent: Read the intended BMC Event Message Buffer and validate its event records without losing, acknowledging or mutating diagnostic evidence.
original_method: Do not execute from the TBD source. Require the exact read method, buffer/channel identity, record schema, cursor/sequence and consumption behavior, bounded scope, criteria and recovery.
manual_activity: Vendor or engineer defines the buffer interface and record semantics; operator approves evidence retention and verifies that a future bounded read cannot clear or consume records unexpectedly.
required_inputs: Vendor Event Message Buffer read specification
Record framing, sequence and timestamp schema
Expected events, SEL/audit correlation and recovery
safety_requirements: No buffer read while core semantics are TBD.
Do not clear logs, SEL or buffer.
Do not acknowledge or consume events by guesswork.
Never perform an unbounded dump or expose sensitive payloads.
Stop on malformed, missing, duplicate or overflowed records.
No automatic retry after uncertain cursor advancement.
agent_execution_scope: Static buffer-contract and evidence planning only while blocked.
No guessed IPMI/vendor command is permitted.
After correction, issue only the approved bounded read and parse records.
Return redacted evidence without assigning the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Define the exact buffer read contract and PASS criteria.
Approve non-consuming or explicitly understood cursor behavior and correlation source.
Own authorization, data handling and recovery for any unexpected consumption.
